decisions: Velocity is the discrete frequency difference between consecutive ordered observation buckets, aligned with a zero value at the first point.
Acceleration is the discrete change in velocity, aligned with zero values for the first two points because two intervals are required.
TopicDynamics accepts either an existing ObservationSeries or raw TopicObservation iterables and returns empty metrics for unknown topics.
The calculation assumes equally spaced canonical periods; it performs no network calls, calendar inference or paid computation.
risks: Irregular calendar gaps are not normalized; later semantics work must define whether rates should be divided by elapsed time.
Metrics operate on frequency only; source diversity and metadata are preserved by observations but are not yet included in dynamics.
